habitat: It forages in grassy vegetation. Wikipedia does not describe the plumage or a Kruger status.
summary: Wikipedia says it is an insectivore that forages in grass across much of sub-Saharan Africa. It does not describe the plumage or say whether Kruger birds are resident, so the marks, status and months were left unset. Newman has no page.

population.notes: Kemp et al. 2001 order-of-magnitude threshold 2^15=32768 mature individuals (resident breeder); paper interval half–double → 16384–65536.

sources.title: Kemp A.C., Herholdt J.J., Whyte I. & Harrison J. (2001). Birds of the two largest national parks in South Africa: a method to generate estimates of population size for all species and assess their conservation ecology. S. Afr. J. Sci. 97: 393–403.

viewNotes.note: Plumage was not described in the text used. It forages in grass.

calls.description: Wikipedia does not describe the call. The file is grade A from near Klerksdorp. The filename says Desert C chatting. A higher-ranked file was not used because its catalogue type includes imitation.

research.note: Newman has no page. Wikipedia and SABAP1 texts used here give no total length, so size is omitted. Status and months were left unset. The Kemp code RB was left unchanged.
